subtitle: A sheltered cove on Ibiza's northwest coast whose seabed sits inside a Balearic government enforcement zone for illegal anchoring on protected Posidonia oceanica meadows.
spike_statement: In 2025, 21% of inspected Ibiza boats were found moored on protected seagrass; one August sweep of Sant Antoni Bay and Cala Bassa cited nine vessels.

levers.photo_tone: Turquoise shallows fading to deep blue over pale sand, dark seagrass shadow patterns visible through clear water, limestone headland edges, small boats crowded close to the anchorage
